steps.content: [Bureau Lounge]

It's early morning. The Bureau lounge is in complete silence. EMP, overtaken by exhaustion, lies slumped awkwardly in a chair, her breathing slow and steady in deep sleep. Labyrinth has also activated her energy-saving mode, entering temporary hibernation.
Among the Sinners keeping watch over the Chief, only Hecate remains awake. She notices the first signs of movement from the previously unresponsive figure, catching the faint sound of mumbling.
Hecate moves closer with concern, trying to make out Chief's words, but what she hears only leaves her more confused.
No thanks, I'm good, really. I already have my own place... Wait, what? That cheap?
No, no, I was talking about the castle, don't change the subject... Huh? You want to buy my place? It's not for sale! That's government property!
[Corridor]

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: So you're THE Chief? Mamma mia, you MBCC folks sure have special dreams, coming all the way out here to get forced into marrying a beautiful bride! Man, why don't I ever get that lucky... Yes, yes, yes, move that ribbon more to the left!
You try to extract more information from her, but she's either busy directing No. 15 and Dullahan in setting up the venue, or habitually steering the conversation back to real estate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Should we wait until you're done with this?

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Don't worry about it! I've got nothing to fret over. I'm standing here in the castle, flesh and blood. You, though... who knows what kind of trick someone pulled to yank your soul out and toss it here... Hey! Those flowers can't be in odd numbers! They must be in pairs!

Soul extraction, astral projection... Luminita is absolutely convinced you're a spirit that drifted here while your body sleeps elsewhere. Could this explain why you lost your memories when you woke up here? But who could possibly do such a thing to you? Though she notices you don't fully trust her theory, she keeps going regardless.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: But a sleepwalking soul that thinks they're really here, and a bride who exists despite being called a ghost—you two make quite the perfect match! If you actually fall for each other, I'd be happy to chip in for the wedding gift.
She gives your shoulder a hearty pat, then glances furtively around the hall. Seeing that no one is watching, she leans in and lowers her voice:

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Morveth Castle has the power to manifest longing into physical form—that's how No. 15 and Dullahan came into existence. But that power alone couldn't possibly target you so precisely, could it? Did you know our beautiful bride before all this?

The agent speaks casually about it, but you can't take this situation lightly. Someone deliberately planted that book in the Bureau, lured you into a dream, and pulled you into this wedding while you were vulnerable. You're no stranger to being trapped in illusions, but the power required to orchestrate something like this is far from ordinary.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't know Graves, but I can't rule out the possibility that someone who knows us both arranged this "match."

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Yep, that's about all I've got, so... congrats on getting married!

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Hey, hey, hey! No. 15, where did you dig up all this junk? Put it back right now, I'm begging you! Decorations are perfect as they are—we don't need your personal collection! Hey, you there, sir! The flame atop your head has completely burned out the flowers!
Luminita's composure is truly remarkable—she effortlessly handles a Sinner on the verge of becoming a Corruptor, two Mania monsters, and you, a wandering spirit, all without missing a beat.

Thanks to her information, regardless of whether it's true or false, it's time to decide. Dullahan's speech may have felt out of place at the wedding, but he was right—an unintentional trap is a hundred times crueler than any calculated harm.
You look up toward the window—dawn is approaching.

Moonlight spills through the high windows, its final rays dancing across the corridor floor. Dust rises into the air one by one, shimmering like tiny stars as the trailing hem of a dress sweeps through—the bride has arrived.

The contamination on her face is gone, her skin restored to the pale, delicate complexion you first saw—this is the "perfect appearance" she wants, one "worthy of a perfect wedding." She must have exerted tremendous effort to suppress that shadow within her.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Let's give the couple some time to themselves! I'm sure they have something important to discuss.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Dullahan, No. 15, hurry up and get ready! Follow my lead! Wait until the couple enters before starting the music.
She makes a theatrical show of retreating into the hall, closing the heavy doors behind her, leaving only you and Graves alone in the corridor.
[Corridor Transition]
Without Luminita, silence reclaims the corridor. You stand shoulder to shoulder facing the ceremonial hall doors, neither of you speaking, the air thick with lingering warmth.

Graves hesitates, then gently lifts the hem of her dress, taking one tentative step toward you, then another. She doesn't stop until the moonlight frames both your shadows together beneath the same stained glass window.

You notice her breathing is quicker than usual, her heartbeat betraying her mix of excitement and nervousness. Her veil sways gently with each tiny movement, the delicate fabric brushing against your shoulder. She steals a few glances at you, darting away before they linger too long.
You know she's waiting for the doors to open and the music to begin—this wedding is her lifelong dream, the ultimate proof that she will never be abandoned again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Graves...

options: I have something I want to tell you.

steps.content: [Confused Graves]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you remember our arrangement? I said I would agree to marry you, and in exchange, you would tell me everything about this place.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I originally just wanted more information to resolve this Mania crisis, but I've realized that the wedding means far more to you than I thought. It's not just your fixation on a ceremony, and it shouldn't have been something I used as a bargaining chip.

She doesn't seem to understand, remaining gentle and attentive, just like when you first met and she served you tea with the innocent formality of a child playing house. She simply tilts her head with a smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want a relationship where you'll never be abandoned again, but I'm not the right person for that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I haven't told you my story yet, have I? It's complicated to explain, but I don't belong here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I come from a place that's more brutal and unforgiving, where you can't befriend Mania creatures, where each day brings countless dangers and challenges. I'm familiar with the "birthplace" you created for me, because I did lie in a coffin for a very long time.
Graves hesitates, looking down at her own hand before uncertainly placing it in yours. Under the light, your elongated shadows finally connect.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't promise you that I'll never abandon you—that promise means too much to you for me to say it lightly. But there is one thing I might be able to help you with...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can take on the suffering of the dark shadow for you, and suppress and eliminate the Mania inside you.

Graves furrows her brow slightly, confusion in her eyes, but before she can speak, you've already begun. A red light emanates from between your tightly clasped hands as the temperature rapidly rises, the glow seeping through the gaps between your fingers. You feel her trying to pull away, but you only grip her hand more firmly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's call off the wedding. Dawn is breaking, and I might wake up and return to my own place soon.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't marry you. Please find someone who can truly make you happy.
[Dramatic music] [Screen shakes]

The malevolent force seeps out from where your hands meet, slowly but steadily detaching from her body and transferring into you through your joined palms. An overwhelming pressure crashes through you instantly, a suffocating force pressing against your mind, crushing your nerves and thoughts into chaos.
You clench your jaw tightly, feeling the force burning through your nerves. Your limbs begin to tremble, yet you refuse to let go of her hand.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You...

She watches helplessly as everything unfolds—watching the nightmares that have haunted her every moment slowly fade, while your knuckles turn white and your hand grows colder. Without thinking, she squeezes your hand, as if trying to share some of her warmth with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm fine, truly. Only my consciousness is here anyway.
Despite your words, your voice has grown noticeably weaker. She tries to speak several times, but in the end, all she can manage is a strained, imperfect smile.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I know nothing about your Bureau or the outside world, but I do know...
She lifts her other hand and gently brushes her fingers across the space between your eyebrows.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You don't want to marry me. You never did, right from the beginning.

The shackles continue their absorption as chaotic, tormented thoughts clamor and invade your mind. Dizziness and exhaustion crash over you like waves, leaving your legs weak and unsteady. Just as you begin to falter, a firm, steady hand braces against your shoulder, holding you upright.
Graves leans against you, shoulder to shoulder, using your interlocked hands to steady you.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Weddings are meant to be joyous occasions, and a worthy bride should never be a burden to you... I'm not good enough. I'm not the perfect partner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not true. You're wonderful, and neither you nor your castle have ever harmed me. When I return, I promise I'll find my way back to you. I'll come in my real body, and we can be friends...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: It's all right. It's all right if you don't like me... Go back now, return to where you truly belong.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You've already given me what I truly wanted.
She gently rests her head on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You've already given me... your genuine sincerity.
[Silence]

The shackles have successfully transferred the shadows to you, and the prelude to the wedding march has begun to play. This is your cue, according to Luminita's plan, to make your entrance. But neither of you moves, you lean against the window, letting the notes of the wedding march fade away.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Before I let you go, would it be too much to ask for one final request?
She keeps her head down, refusing to look up at you.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Stay with me just a little longer, and recite the vows here together.
[Shoulder Rest CG]

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Just repeat after me. Don't worry, this time there's nothing scary like "we shall never be apart"...

You remain side by side, her breath steady and warm against you. The gentle weight against your shoulder creates a comforting presence. Outside the castle, moonlight gradually yields to the first ray of sun, their warm and cool hues blending as they stream through the stained glass windows, bathing you both in dappled light.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: .　　I swear...　　.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: .　　I swear...　　.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: .　　...in life and in death...　　.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: .　　...in life and in death...　　.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: .　　...in darkness and in light...　　.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: .　　...in darkness and in light...　　.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: ...never to forget Graves.

Her veil falls gently, concealing her face and shrouding her expression. Silence envelops you, broken only by the soft movement of light. The air is filled with an ineffable tranquility and tenderness, tinged with a subtle, bittersweet sadness.

options: I will never forget you, Graves.

steps.content: You repeat the words with solemn sincerity. The wedding march plays, its peaceful melody flowing with deep emotion, yet it seems to mark the end of this fleeting moment of happiness.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: This is enough... It's all I need...
A smile remains on her face, as though suspended in this eternal moment, melting softly into the light.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, Graves, for sharing this special wedding with me. I promise I'll come back to find you.
